episodes.title: The Consultation
episodes.summary: Marty is struggling with anxiety, so his sister Phyllis persuades him to start seeing well-regarded psychiatrist Dr. Ike.

episodes.title: The Ceremony
episodes.summary: Dr. Ike convinces Marty to have a second bar mitzvah, which upsets Phyllis.

episodes.title: The Treatment
episodes.summary: Marty invites Dr. Ike to help out with the family business. Phyllis senses she is losing her brother and decides to take matters into her own hands.

episodes.title: The Foundation
episodes.summary: Dr. Ike persuades Marty to start a charity with him. Marty sparks with a female employee at the frame store.

episodes.title: The Family Tree
episodes.summary: When Dr. Ike experiences a death in the family, Marty invites him to come stay at his house in the Hamptons.

episodes.title: The Party
episodes.summary: Dr. Ike and Marty throw a series of extravagant parties at the Hamptons house—mostly at Marty's expense.

episodes.title: The Breakthrough
episodes.summary: Marty considers a company move to New Jersey, but is that a boundary even Dr. Ike can't cross?

episodes.title: The Verdict
episodes.summary: Marty confronts Dr. Ike about his behavior and tries to reconnect with the life he left behind.
